description: This Java class defines a virtual keyboard used in an Android application. It manages keyboard views, key mappings, input handling, and supports different keyboard states such as shift and symbol modes.

classes.name: Keyboard
classes.description: A class controlling the virtual keyboard view, key mappings, and input handling, supporting different keyboard states such as shift and symbol modes.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns a label for special keys based on input data (e.g., shift, delete, symbols).

methods.name: qwerty
methods.description: Creates and returns a Keyboard instance configured with a standard QWERTY key layout.

methods.name: inflateKeyboardView
methods.description: Inflates the keyboard layout and maps the keys to their handlers.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the keyboard state to default and updates key mappings.

methods.name: mapKeys
methods.description: Binds key views to their data labels and click handlers based on current state.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles key press events, toggling states or passing data to the AutofillImeService.
